text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days before Valentine's Day—

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
The end of the line for "Hiam", the 
cutting-edge chocolate brand from Dubai, 
is right over here!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk B
text_block_list.text:
"As seen on TV! Our super popular 
seashell-shaped chocolates are limited in 
quantity! Get yours soon!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew... Another year has begun, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is coming...!
—I am definitely 
going to win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between tasks, my thoughts drifted to 
Verxina. She had slipped away for just a 
few hours to buy Valentine's gifts for
her 
family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she enthusiastically
participates 
every year, gathering intel just to make 
her younger sisters happy, showing 
incredible dedication.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's always working hard for others,
so I 
wanted to show my appreciation... After 
giving it a lot of thought, I decided to 
go with a classic, well-known brand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And then came Valentine's Day."
choice_data_list: (Our goal: the very pinnacle of th...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. Everyone was so happy!
choice_data_list: Did you already give chocolates to...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos was especially thrilled...! It was 
well worth waiting in line for two hours.
choice_data_list: I see, that's great to hear.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...And well, about that."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back then, I caused you trouble with 
adjusting my training and all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, this isn't just for this 
one time, but a thank-you for everything 
up until now."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe this is enough to repay 
you. However... thank you, as always.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...!
choice_data_list: ……Then let me say thanks for every...
……Then let me say thanks for every...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Wait... hold on. Could this brand be...
choice_data_list: It's a pretty famous place, right?
I take it it's a fairly famous place?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Actually... I absolutely love it.
Its 
gentle, melt-in-your-mouth texture is 
utterly enchanting.
choice_data_list: It's a pretty famous spot, right?
It's a pretty famous spot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to eat any lately, so 
I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However... it's a classic brand,
so didn't 
that make it even harder to choose? I was 
researching all sorts of things, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her sisters' sake, Verxina always 
tried to choose fresh new brands each 
year. If that's the case, she'll likely 
avoid the mainstream classics—
choice_data_list: No, I actually thought there was n...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list: When I thought about what was best...
When thinking about what was best ...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Um, about this chocolate...?"
choice_data_list: Of course, you can give some to yo...
Of course, you can give some to yo...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Do you not mind it?
choice_data_list: Of course, you can give some to yo...
Of course, you can give some to yo...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
After taking the trouble to give it all
to 
me, you're asking to share it instead?
choice_data_list: Because I know that brings you the...
Because I know that brings you the...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: Because I can tell that brings you...
Because I can tell that brings you...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious~♡♡ I absolutely love this 
brand!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, are you sure it's okay...? ...It's 
from your Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, don't worry. Go ahead and 
eat as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because you... really understand me so 
well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(To think Trainer-san cared about me that 
much...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if that was enough? I chose a 
more mature brand than what I gave my 
little sisters, but...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Is this really enough?
Can I truly say 
I've considered everything for their
sake? 
Should I head back to the event venue 
right now and get more――)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, even that's not enough. In that 
case...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Phew,
finished melting the extra batch! 
Next is carving the chocolate 
decorations...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not working...!
Is there anything 
else I could use...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...In the back of the second shelf in
the 
fridge. There are edible rose flowers, so 
why don't you use them?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O just forced it on me, and it 
was a nuisance, that's all. If you don't 
want it, throw it away.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you, very much!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the decorations are all set. Now 
for the rest...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Considering the dorm curfew, I'm almost 
out of time... Will I make it in 
time...!?)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'll make it in time! Just like 
when I used to make things for my little 
sisters back then--"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Pour your heart into it and make it 
complete! This race... I am NOT going to 
lose!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, I was suddenly summoned by 
Verxina. And then—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! —Please take this!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a Valentine's chocolate cake.
Freshly 
made and still warm.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Both of them are packed full of... my 
precious feelings for you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: One is my gratitude. The other is...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"A grea— designed with every thought for 
your sake—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I-It's... deep... deep... deep—deepest 
gratitude, from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I am most delighted that you 
enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I almost spoke to them the way I talk to 
my little sisters...
――T-That was close... 
right?)
